{{Top}}
[[File:RexandCompany-Imdb.png|thumb|right|220px|Members of the [[501st Legion/Legends|501st Legion]]]]
{{Quote|It was I who allowed the Alliance to know the location of the shield generator. It is quite safe from your pitiful little band. An entire legion of my best troops awaits them.|Emperor Palpatine, to Luke Skywalker|<ref name="ROTJ">{{Film|VI}}</ref>}}
A '''legion''' was a military unit. Typically, the term indicated a large-scale formation comparable to a [[Division/Legends|division]] or [[Battle group/Legends|battlegroup]], consisting of several [[Regiment/Legends|regiments]] and comprising about ten thousand fighting troops.

==Republic and Empire==
[[File:Captain_Rex_and_his_clone_troopers_on_Teth.png|thumb|left|300px|Clone troopers of the 501st Legion under Captain Rex make a stand.]]
The legion was not a standard element in the line Army forces of either the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] or [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], which identified comparable formations as [[Division/Legends|divisions]] and [[Battle group/Legends|battlegroups]]. It was, however, a key field formation for the white-armored [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] of the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]] and their successors, the [[Stormtrooper Corps/Legends|Stormtrooper Corps]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]].

A clone legion consisted of 9,216 troops, normally headed by a [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi General]] and a [[Senior clone commander]]. A Grand Army of the Republic legion, with some 7,000 attached support personnel, was the standard complement of an [[Acclamator-class transgalactic military assault ship/Legends|''Acclamator''-class assault ship]]. Imperial stormtrooper legions were equal to the size of [[Imperial Army/Legends|Imperial Army]] battlegroups, 8,192 troops, and were likely to have been led by officers of comparable rank to the [[High Colonel/Legends|High Colonels]] and [[Major General]]s of the Imperial Army.

The official field manual for the [[Imperial Military/Legends|Imperial Military]], the ''[[Imperial Handbook: A Commander's Guide]]'', estimated that the total amount within a stormtrooper legion lay between 8,192 and 12,800 troops.<ref name="Star Wars: Imperial Handbook: A Commander's Guide">''[[Star Wars: Imperial Handbook: A Commander's Guide]]''</ref> In addition, although legion was the largest possible unit of the Stormtrooper Corps, various legions from other sectors have been known to join in a major offensive with other legions belonging to the Sector Group where the offensive took place.<ref name="ISB2">[[Imperial Sourcebook (Second Edition)|''Imperial Sourcebook'', Second Edition]]</ref>

[[File:The_Emperors_Legion_NA.png|thumb|right|250px|Emperor Palpatine stationed a legion of his best troops on Endor.]]
Even though the Stormtrooper Corps was the only major Imperial Military branch to utilize legions, various Imperial Military units that included both the Imperial Army and the Imperial Navy could sometimes be compared to legions if the manpower and force strength was sufficient, especially if the unit in question was a joint task force for all three major branches of the Imperial Military utilized for a vital objective. This was especially evident during the Battle of Endor, where the [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Galactic Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]], when revealing to captive [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] commander [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] that the Rebel Alliance's [[Endor strike team/Legends|Endor strike team]] was headed into a trap, referred to the unit guarding the [[Endor shield generator bunker]], [[Tempest Force/Legends|Tempest Force]], as "an entire legion of [Palpatine's] best troops."<ref name="ROTJ" />

==Other legions==
As a unit designation, the legion went back millennia, to the earliest ages of galactic warfare, and it seemed to have been used by adherents of both [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] and [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] traditions. The [[Legions of Lettow]] were the [[Jar'Kai/Legends|Jar'Kai]]-using warriors of [[Xendor]], the earliest recorded [[Dark Jedi/Legends|Dark Jedi]], while in the [[New Sith Wars]] the [[Third Legion of Light]] was one of the major component units of the Jedi [[Army of Light/Legends|Army of Light]].

The [[Mandalorian Neo-Crusaders/Legends|Mandalorian Neo-Crusaders]] used legions during the [[Mandalorian Wars]].

In the period of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] and [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], it was not only clone troopers and stormtroopers who were organized into legions. In particular, the term seems to have been widely used in the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]]: it was said that the [[C-9979 landing craft/Legends|C-9979 landing craft]] which bore the Trade Federation's [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droids]] into action could carry "legions of troops," while the [[Neimoidian/Legends|Neimoidian]] soldiers who guarded [[Neimoidia/Legends|Neimoidia]] and the [[Purse world/Legends|purse worlds]] were known as the [[Neimoidian Home Defense Legion/Legends|Neimoidian Home Defense Legions]].

Further legions were found among the forces of governments at [[Galaxy/Legends|galactic]], [[Sector/Legends|sector]] and [[Planet/Legends|planetary]] levels. The term was used occasionally by Rebel Alliance units, including the feared [[Alderaanian Death Legion]]. The [[Pembric Security Legion]] provided security on [[Pembric II]], although in practice they worked hand-in-glove with the [[Bombaasa Cartel]] to exclude other factions from a ''de facto'' condominium between crime lord [[Crev Bombaasa/Legends|Crev Bombaasa]] and the planetary government.

==Order of battle==
Different legions varied drastically in size and structure: some were armies charged with guarding entire sectors, while others were little more than local gangs. The term connoted size and importance, however, and in the terminology of the Republic and Empire, a legion was a large force composed of several regiments.

The best-documented legion organization was that of the Grand Army of the Republic, in which a standard legion consisted of 9,216 soldiers, as mentioned above. These were divided among four regiments, each of four battalions of 576 men.

Under the Empire, the strength of a stormtrooper battalion had been raised to 820 men, suggesting some restructuring of the legion organization, although it remained a force of several regiments. Stormtrooper legions may also have been closer in number to battlegroups in the Imperial Army, which had approximately 10,000 front-line troops in an overall strength of close to 15,000.

Under the [[Empire of the Hand]], it appears that the [[501st Legion/Legends|501st Legion]] had been reorganized, with the reduction of the standard [[Company/Legends|company]] to forty men; if the companies were all indicated by individual letters of the [[Aurebesh/Legends|Aurebesh]] like [[Aurek Company]], the overall strength may have been no more than 1,360 men.
